title: Module sheafification commutes with restriction at independent universes
statement: Let C:Type u₁ and D:Type u₂ have Hom universes v₁,v₂, let J,K be topologies on them, and let F:C→D be continuous and cocontinuous. Let R be a RingCat.{r}-valued sheaf on D, and put m=max(u₁,u₂,v₁,v₂,r). Assume abelian sheafification and its locally-bijective criterion on both sites in universe m. Restrict module presheaves and module sheaves along F, with the restricted coefficient sheaf on C. The canonical module comparison from sheafification after restriction to restriction after sheafification is a natural isomorphism. It is defined by transposing the restricted global unit under the local sheafification adjunction, and hence preserves the sheafification units.

source.place: Tags 03CY and 03DH, with the naturality argument of Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.SliceModuleSheafification generalized to independent universes.

proof.text: Construct the canonical module map using the local sheafification Hom equivalence and the restricted global sheafification unit. Naturality follows from both Hom-equivalence naturality identities.

After forgetting to abelian presheaves, the local unit followed by the comparison is the restricted global unit. Cocontinuity preserves local injectivity and surjectivity. Cancel the locally bijective local unit. The comparison is a locally bijective map of sheaves and therefore an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: E9: the proof in the Lean module, with the source argument specialized to the stated slice-site interface.
